description: Trigger a Dagster job when a dbt Cloud job run completes.

account_id.label: Account Id
account_id.description: dbt Cloud account ID. Required unless resource_key is set.

job_id.label: Job Id
job_id.description: dbt Cloud job ID to monitor

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var containing the dbt Cloud API token. Required unless resource_key is set.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Dagster job to trigger when dbt run completes

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional resource key registered by a DbtCloudResourceComponent. When set, polls run via that resource's own get_runs(...) method instead of the inline account_id/api_token_env_var above.

name: dbt Cloud Job Sensor
